answer: Gym membership streak with attendance logs is the check: check-ins at one gym recorded month after month. A farm faking 124 aliases needs 124 separate attendance logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Call it the ferrous rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the copper record is open for audit, and the velvet window is too short for 124 aliases to earn their price back.
